prompt:
[Identity Lock | Woman]
Adult female, ~28, straight black hair, fair skin, dark brown eyes; knee-length bright red wool coat, black jeans, black ankle boots; red coat is the dominant color; continuous single actor, no face-swapping or outfit changes.

[Identity Lock | Man]
Adult male, ~30, short dark brown hair, light stubble, light olive skin; navy jacket, grey hoodie, dark jeans; holding two white paper coffee cups without logos; continuous single actor, no face-swapping or outfit changes.

[Space]
Fixed geography: ~15m wide two-lane urban street flanked by storefronts; warm-lit cafe on left with glass door facing street; glass bus stop on right facing cafe; street extends to horizon; meteor streaks from top right to horizon, exploding outside city; dust wall surges towards camera; he exits cafe on left, she waits at bus stop on right, meeting in street center without screen direction inversion; ~10 pedestrians.

[First Frame]
24mm low-angle wide shot looking down street; quiet night street, shop lights, streetlamps, dark sky; top-right sky glows bright orange-white.

[Timeline / SHOT 1]
0.0–4.0s | 24mm low wide upward tilt: 0.0–1.5s sky lights up brighter than day, cast shadows swing rapidly; 1.5–3.0s pedestrians gaze up as massive burning meteor streaks across top-right sky towards horizon; 3.0–4.0s meteor glare reflects on cafe door glass, creating first match cut.

[Timeline / SHOT 2]
4.0–9.0s | Match cut from glare, 35mm handheld outside cafe: 4.0–5.5s he pushes door open holding two coffees, looks up and halts; 5.5–7.0s he sees her across the street at the bus stop, eyes meet; 7.0–8.0s both sprint into street; 8.0–9.0s massive white explosion at horizon washes out screen, creating second match cut.

[Timeline / SHOT 3]
9.0–15.0s | Match cut from whiteout, 35mm elevated street view: 9.0–11.0s whiteout fades to mushroom cloud and orange fireball; 11.0–13.5s shockwave blasts storefront windows successively towards camera, alarms blare, dust wall rolls forward; both sprint towards street center; 13.5–15.0s nearest window shatters toward lens, creating third match cut.

[Timeline / SHOT 4]
15.0–19.0s | Match cut from flying glass, 50mm eye-level profile, both in street center: 15.0–17.0s reaching out, he drops both coffees, liquid spills, glass whirls, dust wall 20m away, wind pulls hair; 17.0s time abruptly freezes completely; 17.0–19.0s absolute standstill except she slowly blinks, creating fourth match cut.

[Timeline / SHOT 5]
19.0–25.0s | Match cut from blink, 35mm handheld over her right shoulder: 19.0–20.5s realizing she can move, she looks around; 20.5–23.5s steps forward through suspended shards, gently deflects a floating glass shard which stays in place; passes frozen coffee spill, frozen pigeon, frozen pedestrians, frozen fiery dust wall; 23.5–25.0s approaches him and reaches out, creating fifth match cut.

[Timeline / SHOT 6]
25.0–30.0s | Match cut from reaching hand, 50mm close profile: 25.0–26.5s fingertips touch his frozen cheek; 26.5–28.0s he blinks, inhales, looks at her and unfreezes, clasping her hand; 28.0–30.0s adjacent suspended glass shard vibrates and drops; both watch it fall; scene cuts mid-fall.

[Physics]
Meteor illumination realistically shifts street shadows; shockwave shatters glass sequentially outward; dust wall is volumetric fire/dust; time freeze is total for all background elements with zero motion blur or drift; deflected shard stays at new position; gravity resumes on moving subjects; only final shard vibrates and drops.

[Cinematography]
6 sequential camera setups; 5 match cuts matched to ending elements (reflection, flash, shard, blink, hand); camera static during freeze except Shot 5 tracking; no slow motion, no hero low-angles.

[Lighting/Color]
Opens cold blue with warm shop light; switches to harsh orange-white under meteor; orange-red explosion lighting; frozen world back-lit by fire inside dust wall; red coat remains focal point.

[Audio]
Shot 1 quiet traffic to escalating roar; Shot 2 doorbell, footsteps, distant impact; Shot 3 blast roar, shattering windows, alarms; Shot 4 wind/glass noise abruptly cuts to dead silence at 17s; Shot 5 quiet footsteps on glass and soft breath; Shot 6 sharp inhale and gentle glass hum.

[Locks]
Strictly 6 shots, 5 match cuts; zero spoken dialogue; continuous outfits and character identities without fusion; exact anatomical consistency; live-action film realism; video cuts while the shard falls.

gm gm AI Video Creators

Created this video on Seedance 2.5 using just mandarin text prompt, no attachments. 
Prompt given below  

Opus 5.5 is crazy polishing up the rough ideas and choreography.  

Made with @Flovaai
#flovaai #flovacpp

Prompt: 

「身份锁定｜女人」
成年女性，约二十八岁，黑色长直发，浅色皮肤，深棕色眼睛；身穿及膝的亮红色羊毛大衣、黑色牛仔裤、黑色短靴；亮红色大衣是画面中最醒目的颜色；全程同一人、同一服装，不换脸、不变装。

「身份锁定｜男人」
成年男性，约三十岁，深棕色短发，下巴有浅浅的胡茬，浅橄榄色皮肤；身穿深海军蓝夹克、灰色连帽衫、深色牛仔裤；开场双手各拿一杯白色纸杯咖啡（杯身无任何文字或标志）；全程同一人、同一服装，不换脸、不变装。

「空间」
固定地理：一条约十五米宽的双车道城市街道，两侧是带大玻璃橱窗的商店；街道左侧是一家亮着暖光的咖啡馆，玻璃门朝向街道；街道右侧正对着咖啡馆的是一个玻璃顶的公交车站；街道笔直延伸向远方，尽头是城市的地平线，陨石从画面右上方划向远方地平线，撞击发生在大街尽头的城外，尘墙从大街尽头沿街道朝镜头方向推进；他从左侧咖啡馆出来，她在右侧公交站，两人在街道中央相遇，左右关系全程不翻转；街上还有约十名行人。

「首帧」
24mm街道中央低位广角，朝向大街尽头，第一帧是安静的深夜街道：橱窗灯光、路灯、零星行人，夜空漆黑；此刻天空右上方已经开始泛起一片刺眼的橙白色光。

「时间轴 / SHOT 1」
0.0–4.0秒｜24mm街道低位广角，缓慢上仰：0.0–1.5秒天空在一瞬间由漆黑变得比白昼还亮，橙白色的强光照亮整条街，所有路灯、行人、停着的汽车的影子在路面上同时快速转动、扫过；1.5–3.0秒行人纷纷停下抬头，一颗山一样巨大的燃烧陨石拖着熊熊火焰与滚滚浓烟，从画面右上方划过夜空、飞向大街尽头的地平线，天空被它的火尾撕开；3.0–4.0秒陨石的强光在左侧咖啡馆的玻璃门上反射出一道耀眼的光斑，形成第一次动作匹配剪切。

「时间轴 / SHOT 2」
4.0–9.0秒｜从同一道玻璃门上的反射光斑切入，35mm手持在咖啡馆门外：4.0–5.5秒他推开玻璃门走出来，双手各拿一杯咖啡，抬头看见天空，脚步停住；5.5–7.0秒他低下头，目光穿过街道，看见对面公交站下穿红色大衣的她，她也正看着他，两人隔着街道对视；7.0–8.0秒两人同时迈步，冲向街道中央，他仍然攥着两杯咖啡；8.0–9.0秒大街尽头的地平线上爆出一团巨大的白光，白光瞬间吞没整个画面，形成第二次动作匹配剪切。

「时间轴 / SHOT 3」
9.0–15.0秒｜从同一团白光切入，35mm在街道中央略高处，朝大街尽头望去：9.0–11.0秒白光褪去，大街尽头的地平线上，一团橙红色的火光与蘑菇状尘云冲天而起；11.0–13.5秒冲击波沿着大街一路推来，两侧的橱窗从远到近一扇接一扇依次炸碎，玻璃向街心喷射，汽车警报响成一片，路边的汽车被推得晃动；一堵数十层楼高、内部翻滚着橙红火光的灰褐色尘墙沿着大街朝镜头方向席卷而来；他从画面左侧、她从画面右侧冲进画面，朝街心奔跑；13.5–15.0秒最近的一扇橱窗在镜头旁炸开，一大片玻璃碎片朝镜头飞来，形成第三次动作匹配剪切。

「时间轴 / SHOT 4」
15.0–19.0秒｜从同一片飞来的玻璃碎片切入，50mm侧面平视，两人位于街道中央，画面左侧是他、右侧是她，背景是逼近的尘墙：15.0–17.0秒两人相距只有三步，彼此伸出手，他松开双手，两杯咖啡翻滚着落下、咖啡泼溅而出，玻璃碎片在他们周围飞旋，尘墙已近在二十米外，她的头发和大衣被风压向后扬起；17.0秒一切骤然静止——空中的玻璃碎片、泼溅的咖啡、翻滚的纸杯、她扬起的头发、尘墙与其中的火焰、远处奔跑的行人全部定格在原位，没有任何运动；17.0–19.0秒整个画面完全静止，唯一的变化是她的眼睛缓缓眨了一下，形成第四次动作匹配剪切。

「时间轴 / SHOT 5」
19.0–25.0秒｜从同一双眨动的眼睛切入，35mm手持跟在她右肩后方：19.0–20.5秒她发现自己能动，缓缓环顾四周，她的头发和大衣随着她的动作重新垂下；20.5–23.5秒她小心地向前迈步，穿过成千上万片悬停在空中的玻璃碎片，碎片在橙红火光中闪烁；她用指尖轻轻推开挡在面前的一片玻璃，那片玻璃被推到旁边后就停在新的位置不再移动；她经过悬在半空的咖啡泼溅与翻滚中定格的纸杯、一只张开翅膀悬停在空中的鸽子、定格在奔跑姿势中的行人；尘墙像一道翻滚中被冻住的悬崖，火焰在其中凝固不动；23.5–25.0秒她走到定格的他面前，抬起右手伸向他的脸，形成第五次动作匹配剪切。

「时间轴 / SHOT 6」
25.0–30.0秒｜从同一只抬起的手切入，50mm两人侧面近景，背景是凝固的尘墙与悬停的玻璃：25.0–26.5秒她的指尖轻轻触碰到他定格的脸颊；26.5–28.0秒他眨了一下眼，胸口吸进一口气，眼珠转动，看向她——他也能动了；两人近在咫尺地对视，他抬手握住她的手；28.0–30.0秒就在他们身旁，一片悬停的玻璃碎片开始轻轻颤动，随后缓缓向下落去，两人同时转头看向那片下落的玻璃，画面在玻璃下落的过程中截断。

「物理」
陨石的强光真实地改变整条街的照明与影子方向；冲击波使橱窗按距离由远到近依次碎裂，玻璃从窗框向外喷射；尘墙是真实翻滚的灰尘与火焰体积；静止时刻是绝对的：除了她（以及之后的他）以外，一切物体保持在原位、原姿态，没有运动模糊、没有漂移；她推开的那片玻璃停留在被推到的新位置；静止前她头发和大衣被风扬起，她开始移动后，她身上的头发和衣物恢复受重力自然下垂；只有结尾那一片玻璃开始颤动并下落，其余一切仍保持静止；碎裂的橱窗、悬停的碎片与尘墙跨越所有剪切持续存在，绝不复原。

「镜头」
SHOT 1街道低位广角上仰揭示陨石，SHOT 2咖啡馆门外手持，SHOT 3街心略高处望向大街尽头看冲击波与尘墙，SHOT 4两人侧面平视直到定格，SHOT 5手持跟在她肩后穿过静止的世界，SHOT 6两人侧面近景；五次剪切都从上一个镜头结束时的同一元素切入（玻璃门反射光斑、白光、飞来的玻璃碎片、眨动的眼睛、抬起的手）；定格时刻摄影机也保持静止，只有在SHOT 5她移动时摄影机才跟随她移动；无慢动作、无英雄仰角、无胜利定格。

「光线/色彩」
开场深夜冷蓝色调与暖黄橱窗灯光；陨石出现后整条街被橙白色强光照亮、影子剧烈转动；冲击波与尘墙阶段为翻滚的橙红火光与灰褐尘雾；静止世界被尘墙内凝固的橙红火光从背后照亮，悬停的玻璃碎片反射出无数橙色光点；她的亮红色大衣始终是画面中最醒目的颜色。

「声音」
SHOT 1 <夜晚街道的安静车流、陨石划过天空的低沉轰鸣与空气撕裂声逐渐增强>；SHOT 2 <咖啡馆门铃与门被推开、他的脚步声、远方撞击的爆鸣>；SHOT 3 <冲击波的巨大轰响、橱窗依次爆碎、汽车警报连成一片、尘墙翻滚的低沉咆哮>；SHOT 4 <狂风与玻璃飞旋的声音在17秒戛然而止，变成完全的静止>；SHOT 5 <只有她的脚步踩在碎玻璃上的细响与她的呼吸，她推开玻璃时一声轻微的玻璃触碰声>；SHOT 6 <他吸进一口气的声音、两人的呼吸、那片玻璃开始颤动时细微的嗡嗡震响>。

「锁定」
严格六个镜头、五次动作匹配剪切；全片无对白、无人声说话；她的红色大衣与他的深蓝夹克全程不变，两人不换脸、不融合；静止后除了她、之后的他、以及结尾那一片玻璃以外，一切保持绝对静止、不漂移；碎裂的橱窗、悬停的玻璃碎片、定格的咖啡与鸽子、凝固的尘墙持续存在，绝不复原；每人两臂两腿、每手五指；全片保持真人实拍质感；结尾那片玻璃下落过程中画面截断。

prompt.englishText:
[Identity Lock | Woman]
Adult female, ~28, straight black hair, fair skin, dark brown eyes; knee-length bright red wool coat, black jeans, black ankle boots; red coat is the dominant color; continuous single actor, no face-swapping or outfit changes.

[Identity Lock | Man]
Adult male, ~30, short dark brown hair, light stubble, light olive skin; navy jacket, grey hoodie, dark jeans; holding two white paper coffee cups without logos; continuous single actor, no face-swapping or outfit changes.

[Space]
Fixed geography: ~15m wide two-lane urban street flanked by storefronts; warm-lit cafe on left with glass door facing street; glass bus stop on right facing cafe; street extends to horizon; meteor streaks from top right to horizon, exploding outside city; dust wall surges towards camera; he exits cafe on left, she waits at bus stop on right, meeting in street center without screen direction inversion; ~10 pedestrians.

[First Frame]
24mm low-angle wide shot looking down street; quiet night street, shop lights, streetlamps, dark sky; top-right sky glows bright orange-white.

[Timeline / SHOT 1]
0.0–4.0s | 24mm low wide upward tilt: 0.0–1.5s sky lights up brighter than day, cast shadows swing rapidly; 1.5–3.0s pedestrians gaze up as massive burning meteor streaks across top-right sky towards horizon; 3.0–4.0s meteor glare reflects on cafe door glass, creating first match cut.

[Timeline / SHOT 2]
4.0–9.0s | Match cut from glare, 35mm handheld outside cafe: 4.0–5.5s he pushes door open holding two coffees, looks up and halts; 5.5–7.0s he sees her across the street at the bus stop, eyes meet; 7.0–8.0s both sprint into street; 8.0–9.0s massive white explosion at horizon washes out screen, creating second match cut.

[Timeline / SHOT 3]
9.0–15.0s | Match cut from whiteout, 35mm elevated street view: 9.0–11.0s whiteout fades to mushroom cloud and orange fireball; 11.0–13.5s shockwave blasts storefront windows successively towards camera, alarms blare, dust wall rolls forward; both sprint towards street center; 13.5–15.0s nearest window shatters toward lens, creating third match cut.

[Timeline / SHOT 4]
15.0–19.0s | Match cut from flying glass, 50mm eye-level profile, both in street center: 15.0–17.0s reaching out, he drops both coffees, liquid spills, glass whirls, dust wall 20m away, wind pulls hair; 17.0s time abruptly freezes completely; 17.0–19.0s absolute standstill except she slowly blinks, creating fourth match cut.

[Timeline / SHOT 5]
19.0–25.0s | Match cut from blink, 35mm handheld over her right shoulder: 19.0–20.5s realizing she can move, she looks around; 20.5–23.5s steps forward through suspended shards, gently deflects a floating glass shard which stays in place; passes frozen coffee spill, frozen pigeon, frozen pedestrians, frozen fiery dust wall; 23.5–25.0s approaches him and reaches out, creating fifth match cut.

[Timeline / SHOT 6]
25.0–30.0s | Match cut from reaching hand, 50mm close profile: 25.0–26.5s fingertips touch his frozen cheek; 26.5–28.0s he blinks, inhales, looks at her and unfreezes, clasping her hand; 28.0–30.0s adjacent suspended glass shard vibrates and drops; both watch it fall; scene cuts mid-fall.

[Physics]
Meteor illumination realistically shifts street shadows; shockwave shatters glass sequentially outward; dust wall is volumetric fire/dust; time freeze is total for all background elements with zero motion blur or drift; deflected shard stays at new position; gravity resumes on moving subjects; only final shard vibrates and drops.

[Cinematography]
6 sequential camera setups; 5 match cuts matched to ending elements (reflection, flash, shard, blink, hand); camera static during freeze except Shot 5 tracking; no slow motion, no hero low-angles.

[Lighting/Color]
Opens cold blue with warm shop light; switches to harsh orange-white under meteor; orange-red explosion lighting; frozen world back-lit by fire inside dust wall; red coat remains focal point.

[Audio]
Shot 1 quiet traffic to escalating roar; Shot 2 doorbell, footsteps, distant impact; Shot 3 blast roar, shattering windows, alarms; Shot 4 wind/glass noise abruptly cuts to dead silence at 17s; Shot 5 quiet footsteps on glass and soft breath; Shot 6 sharp inhale and gentle glass hum.

[Locks]
Strictly 6 shots, 5 match cuts; zero spoken dialogue; continuous outfits and character identities without fusion; exact anatomical consistency; live-action film realism; video cuts while the shard falls.

result.evidence: The video reproduces the described 6-shot sequence: meteor flash over street, man exiting cafe with coffees, horizon explosion, run towards center, mid-air freeze of coffee and glass shards, and interaction during standstill. Note: Inspected via low-bitrate preview stream.

「身份锁定｜男人」
成年男性，约三十岁，深棕色短发，下巴有浅浅的胡茬，浅橄榄色皮肤；身穿深海军蓝夹克、灰色连帽衫、深色牛仔裤；开场双手各拿一杯白色纸杯咖啡（杯身无任何文字或标志）；全程同一人、同一服装，不换脸、不变装。

translations.en:
[Identity Lock | Woman]
Adult female, ~28, straight black hair, fair skin, dark brown eyes; knee-length bright red wool coat, black jeans, black ankle boots; red coat is the dominant color; continuous single actor, no face-swapping or outfit changes.

[Identity Lock | Man]
Adult male, ~30, short dark brown hair, light stubble, light olive skin; navy jacket, grey hoodie, dark jeans; holding two white paper coffee cups without logos; continuous single actor, no face-swapping or outfit changes.

[Space]
Fixed geography: ~15m wide two-lane urban street flanked by storefronts; warm-lit cafe on left with glass door facing street; glass bus stop on right facing cafe; street extends to horizon; meteor streaks from top right to horizon, exploding outside city; dust wall surges towards camera; he exits cafe on left, she waits at bus stop on right, meeting in street center without screen direction inversion; ~10 pedestrians.

[First Frame]
24mm low-angle wide shot looking down street; quiet night street, shop lights, streetlamps, dark sky; top-right sky glows bright orange-white.

[Timeline / SHOT 1]
0.0–4.0s | 24mm low wide upward tilt: 0.0–1.5s sky lights up brighter than day, cast shadows swing rapidly; 1.5–3.0s pedestrians gaze up as massive burning meteor streaks across top-right sky towards horizon; 3.0–4.0s meteor glare reflects on cafe door glass, creating first match cut.

[Timeline / SHOT 2]
4.0–9.0s | Match cut from glare, 35mm handheld outside cafe: 4.0–5.5s he pushes door open holding two coffees, looks up and halts; 5.5–7.0s he sees her across the street at the bus stop, eyes meet; 7.0–8.0s both sprint into street; 8.0–9.0s massive white explosion at horizon washes out screen, creating second match cut.

[Timeline / SHOT 3]
9.0–15.0s | Match cut from whiteout, 35mm elevated street view: 9.0–11.0s whiteout fades to mushroom cloud and orange fireball; 11.0–13.5s shockwave blasts storefront windows successively towards camera, alarms blare, dust wall rolls forward; both sprint towards street center; 13.5–15.0s nearest window shatters toward lens, creating third match cut.

[Timeline / SHOT 4]
15.0–19.0s | Match cut from flying glass, 50mm eye-level profile, both in street center: 15.0–17.0s reaching out, he drops both coffees, liquid spills, glass whirls, dust wall 20m away, wind pulls hair; 17.0s time abruptly freezes completely; 17.0–19.0s absolute standstill except she slowly blinks, creating fourth match cut.

[Timeline / SHOT 5]
19.0–25.0s | Match cut from blink, 35mm handheld over her right shoulder: 19.0–20.5s realizing she can move, she looks around; 20.5–23.5s steps forward through suspended shards, gently deflects a floating glass shard which stays in place; passes frozen coffee spill, frozen pigeon, frozen pedestrians, frozen fiery dust wall; 23.5–25.0s approaches him and reaches out, creating fifth match cut.

[Timeline / SHOT 6]
25.0–30.0s | Match cut from reaching hand, 50mm close profile: 25.0–26.5s fingertips touch his frozen cheek; 26.5–28.0s he blinks, inhales, looks at her and unfreezes, clasping her hand; 28.0–30.0s adjacent suspended glass shard vibrates and drops; both watch it fall; scene cuts mid-fall.

[Physics]
Meteor illumination realistically shifts street shadows; shockwave shatters glass sequentially outward; dust wall is volumetric fire/dust; time freeze is total for all background elements with zero motion blur or drift; deflected shard stays at new position; gravity resumes on moving subjects; only final shard vibrates and drops.

[Cinematography]
6 sequential camera setups; 5 match cuts matched to ending elements (reflection, flash, shard, blink, hand); camera static during freeze except Shot 5 tracking; no slow motion, no hero low-angles.

[Lighting/Color]
Opens cold blue with warm shop light; switches to harsh orange-white under meteor; orange-red explosion lighting; frozen world back-lit by fire inside dust wall; red coat remains focal point.

[Audio]
Shot 1 quiet traffic to escalating roar; Shot 2 doorbell, footsteps, distant impact; Shot 3 blast roar, shattering windows, alarms; Shot 4 wind/glass noise abruptly cuts to dead silence at 17s; Shot 5 quiet footsteps on glass and soft breath; Shot 6 sharp inhale and gentle glass hum.

[Locks]
Strictly 6 shots, 5 match cuts; zero spoken dialogue; continuous outfits and character identities without fusion; exact anatomical consistency; live-action film realism; video cuts while the shard falls.

analysis.useCase: Cinematic sci-fi scene generation via prompt orchestration

promptValidation.evidence: The video reproduces the described 6-shot sequence: meteor flash over street, man exiting cafe with coffees, horizon explosion, run towards center, mid-air freeze of coffee and glass shards, and interaction during standstill. Note: Inspected via low-bitrate preview stream.
